creativeThesis: Follow one injured man home, and discover why surviving twice became a lifelong burden of witness.
viewerExperience: Intimate documented identity → business-trip city → restrained light and injury → homeward geographic/train transition → second workplace light → family survival amid mass loss → precise recognition, plural survivors and abolition witness.
emotionalTarget: Astonishment settles into understanding, empathy and remembrance.
visualThesis: One engineer anchors two clearly separated city/date environments; moving through rail geography makes the impossible sequence understandable before the second restrained light event.

decisions.treatment: Original built-in imagegen period environments and consistent plausible young Japanese engineer; deterministic2.5D depth, occlusion, paper/light animation and authored map.
decisions.rationale: Detail and continuity must serve a human historical film; no third-party archive or unlicensed testimony media.

decisions.treatment: Natural muted olive work clothes, warm skin and morning light, blue-grey rail distance, charcoal damaged environment, warm/cool window light; no universal sepia/grain or fake archive damage.
decisions.rationale: Chronology and environmental consequences shape image changes. Graphic injuries, fireballs and mushroom-cloud montages excluded.

decisions.treatment: Primary local Kokoro af_heart around natural speed1; measured complete semantic takes and modest dramatic pauses.
decisions.rationale: Compelling respectful documentary reading, no sensational voice acting or new audition. Proper names need input and output inspection.

decisions.treatment: Manrope600 ivory56px speech-first phrases on unobtrusive lower gradient, complete words/qualifiers; sparse independent dates/city labels.
decisions.rationale: Caption contrast across full-bleed images and geographic clarity; no karaoke, tiny footnotes or prose-heavy slides.

decisions.treatment: Original quiet room/rail air, subdued wheel rhythm during travel, brief reduction in ambience at the two light events, soft room return. No music required.
decisions.rationale: Avoid explosive impacts, triumphant harmony, tinnitus as literal medical claim or manipulated victim emotion. Effects are reconstructed ambience, not field recordings.

decisions.treatment: 50–65seconds, measured136-word narration; train/map transition gets room and second event follows clearly established city/date.
decisions.rationale: Story-led pace; no monetization padding, no rapid casualty spectacle.

decisions.treatment: He survived an atomic bomb. Three days later, he survived another.
decisions.rationale: Intimate portrait at frame0 with true-story identity and reconstruction disclosure; truthful two-event contrast.

decisions.treatment: 1080x1920 at30fps;56px captions inside conservative insets; explicit AI reconstruction disclosure and all caption midpoints measured.
decisions.rationale: Four provisional profile projections; real-device/native UI/crop remain unknown. No variants or deliveries authorized.
